description: Fork of exp648 (tiny SOTA = 1.4827 @ 61.34M, bs=16, E=192). Architectural pivot: remove per-layer residual_lut accumulation; apply a SINGLE final_residual_lut once at the end. final_residual_tph = 384 (= 6 * 64, residual_tph * num_layers), so total residual_lut weights are param-matched (1*64*64*384*6 = 1*384*64*384 = 9.44M). D=384 is no longer a dual residual stream — it's an intermediate dim before the unembedder. Expected total params ~61.34M (matched). Saves 5/6 residual_lut forward passes per token (faster). Tests whether a single high-tph projection at the end carries enough information vs the 6-step accumulation. Reference: exp648 = 1.4827, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
